name: quick-css-modules
description: Smart navigation, auto-creation, and refactoring for CSS Modules with support for SCSS, LESS, Stylus, and Vue

quick-css-modules.enableTypeScriptPlugin.description: Enable TypeScript plugin to automatically filter .d.ts files from Go to Definition (F12). When enabled, Ctrl+Click will directly open CSS modules without showing .d.ts files.

quick-css-modules.enableAutoImport.description: Enable auto-import suggestions for CSS modules. When typing configured variable names (e.g., 'styles.'), the extension will suggest CSS classes and automatically add the import statement.

quick-css-modules.autoImportVariableName.description: Variable names that trigger CSS module auto-import suggestions. When typing these names followed by a dot (e.g., 'styles.'), the extension will suggest CSS classes and auto-import the module.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
